llm.reply:
The retrieved trials are all studies of thyroid cancer, not of a carcinoma recorded as not otherwise specified [1][2][3][4][5]. The not-otherwise-specified carcinoma entries appear only as disease records, with no trial linked to them [6][10][13].

## Thyroid cancer trials

Radioimmunotherapy With or Without Chemotherapy Plus Peripheral Stem Cell Transplantation in Treating Patients With Thyroid Cancer [1]. Thalidomide in Treating Patients With Thyroid Cancer [2]. Irinotecan in Treating Patients With Metastatic or Inoperable Thyroid Cancer [3].

## Advanced thyroid disease trials

Tanespimycin in Treating Patients With Inoperable Locoregionally Advanced or Metastatic Thyroid Cancer [4]. Suberoylanilide Hydroxamic Acid in Treating Patients With Metastatic and/or Locally Advanced or Locally Recurrent Thyroid Cancer [5].

## NOS disease records

Medullary Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [6]. Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [10]. Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [13]. In a population-based breast cancer registry study, the not-otherwise-specified category had the lowest survival among the microscopically confirmed groups [17: "the 5-year relative survival ranged from 66% (95% CI 61-71) for NOS carcinoma to 95% (95% CI 90-100) for special types"].

llm.reply:
The retrieved trials are all thyroid cancer studies, and none is explicitly labelled carcinoma not otherwise specified; one example is Thalidomide in Treating Patients With Thyroid Cancer [2]. The carcinoma NOS entities appear as disease records, not trial conditions, so these results only partly answer the question.

## Thyroid Cancer Trials

One trial is Radioimmunotherapy With or Without Chemotherapy Plus Peripheral Stem Cell Transplantation in Treating Patients With Thyroid Cancer [1]. Another is Irinotecan in Treating Patients With Metastatic or Inoperable Thyroid Cancer [3]. A further trial is Tanespimycin in Treating Patients With Inoperable Locoregionally Advanced or Metastatic Thyroid Cancer [4]. The last is Suberoylanilide Hydroxamic Acid in Treating Patients With Metastatic and/or Locally Advanced or Locally Recurrent Thyroid Cancer [5].

## NOS Disease Records

One disease record is Medullary Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [6]. Another is Primary Intraosseous Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified, Derived from Odontogenic Cyst [7]. A related record is Infiltrating duct carcinoma of breast [8]. Another is Primary Intraosseous Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified, Derived from Odontogenic Keratocyst [9]. A renal record is Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [10]. Another is Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [11]. A third renal record is Locally Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [12]. A cervical record is Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [13].

## Supporting Literature

The MedGen entry is titled Medullary Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [15]. A related paper is PMID 15365566 [16]. Its title is Prognostic value of morphology and hormone receptor status in breast cancer - a population-based study. [14]. In that registry cohort, NOS breast carcinoma had the lowest survival among the microscopically confirmed categories [17: "the 5-year relative survival ranged from 66% (95% CI 61-71) for NOS carcinoma"]. Tumour morphology independently predicted outcome [17: "Morphology and hormone receptor status were confirmed as significant survival predictors"].
